feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 15 May 2026 11:37am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 15 May 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

A weak transient ridge will build into the Irish Sea, before a weather front arrives from the west tomorrow.


##Wind##

Mainly North or Northwest 4 or 5 today, but falling 3 or 4 in the southwest of the area. Decreasing Northwest 3 or 4 in all waters early tonight, backing West later in the night or at first tomorrow morning, South or Southwest late morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling slight tonight.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain and drizzle reaching far west later tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain and drizzle in far west later tomorrow morning.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4, backing South or Southeast tomorrow afternoon, then veering West 4 or 5 in the evening, possibly occasionally 6 in south of area. Little change overnight, then backing Southwest 4 or 5 on Sunday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate, mainly moderate for a time.


##Weather##

Rain and drizzle soon spreading to all waters, then becoming fair later in evening or at first overnight into Sunday.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor for a time in rain and drizzle.
